text:
Anya: Morning — quick ask. TelemetryCo engineer needs to look at a batch of prod traces to diagnose a regression. Can we give them console access just to view traces/logging for one project for ~2 hours? Need least-privilege + redaction guarantee.

Ben: Prefer project-scoped access not org Viewer. What exact resources do they need? Cloud Trace UI? Logs Viewer? BigQuery read for telemetry_traces dataset?

Sahil: For these traces they need: Trace Viewer (roles/cloudtrace.viewer) on project, Logging Viewer (roles/logging.viewer), and BigQuery Data Viewer (roles/bigquery.dataViewer) on the telemetry dataset. No write perms. Make sure they cannot see raw prompt fields — we store those in proto field `full_user_input` which must be masked.

Anya: 2-hour window only. Can we do JIT with an auto-expiring grant? I don't want to create long-lived SA keys.

Ben: Yes — use our JIT flow. Steps I suggest: 1) create a scoped service account `jit-telemetry@<proj>.iam.gserviceaccount.com` 2) bind the three roles at project/dataset scope 3) grant a short-lived OAuth token via our JIT portal that expires in 2h 4) the security-bot will auto-remove bindings after expiry. Avoid issuing SA key files.

Sahil: Also add these controls before granting: a) redact `full_user_input` column in BigQuery view (create a sanitized view) OR restrict the dataset to only the sanitized view, b) require consultant to sign DPA and provide IP allowlist for the session, c) enable audit logging for any read access to the dataset.

Anya: Sounds good. Can someone create the sanitized view and the JIT request? I can do the DPA and vendor onboarding.

Ben: I’ll create the sanitized view. Quick SQL I’ll use: ```CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW telemetry_sanitized AS SELECT trace_id, ts, json_payload EXCEPT(full_user_input) FROM `project.telemetry_traces.raw`;``` Then only give BigQuery read on `telemetry_sanitized`.

Sahil: Also add a Data Loss Prevention (DLP) scan on the view before granting access, just to be safe.

Anya: Great. Ben — ping me when you open the JIT so I can approve DPA.

security-bot: JIT request created: JIT-1746254321-TELEMETRY. Grant: roles/cloudtrace.viewer, roles/logging.viewer (project: prod-telemetry), bigquery.dataViewer on dataset telemetry_sanitized. Expiry: 2026-06-18T14:45:21Z. Auto-removal scheduled.

ops-oncall: FYI — I confirmed audit logging is enabled for reads on the dataset and trace API. Will watch for any anomalies during the window. :eyes:
